intent.proves: At least one non-image asset of an active product carries a version label.
intent.scope: active products of the declared product scope, every language; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_product_images reads one product at a time; no complete host enumeration of details. The detail DTO does not establish the version field.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailType = 0 AND ISNULL(d.DetailVersion, N'') <> N'' AND NOT (LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpeg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.png' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.gif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webp' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.svg') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = d.DetailProductId AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope})
